# Final Numbers (Auto-generated)

> **These numbers are superseded and partly withdrawn.**
>
> The diffusion RMSE below (152 / 214 / 258) was produced by a diverging sampler and
> does not measure reconstruction quality. See
> [SAMPLER_FIX.md](SAMPLER_FIX.md) — the same weights with a corrected sampler give
> ~0.017. The observed-region figures near 1e-7 are float32 round-trip error, guaranteed
> by the sampler overwriting observed pixels, and confirm nothing.
>
> The VAE numbers are real, but were reported without any baseline. Persistence scores
> 0.057 at 6 h against the VAE's 1.10, so the forecaster has no skill at any lead.
>
> This file is regenerated by `tools/finalize_report_assets.py` and will be replaced on
> the next cluster run.
